Kaaf-Haa-Yaa-Aen-Suad
yeh tazkarah hai uss rehmat ka jo tumharay perwerdigar ney apney banday zakriya per ki thi .
yeh uss waqt ki baat hai jab unhon ney apney perwerdigar ko aahista aahista aawaz say pukara tha .

unhon ney kaha tha kay :  meray perwerdigar ! meri haddiyan tak kamzor parr-gai hain , aur sar burhapay ki safedi say bharak utha hai , aur meray perwerdigar ! mein aap say dua maang ker kabhi na-murad nahi huwa .
aur mujhay apney baad apney chachazaad bhaiyon ka andesha laga huwa hai ,   aur meri biwi baanjh hai , lehaza aap khaas apney paas say mujhay aik aisa waris ata ker-dijiye
jo mera bhi waris ho , aur Yaqoob ( aleh-assalam ) ki aulad say bhi meeras paye .   aur ya rab ! ussay aisa banaiye jo ( khud aap ka ) pasandeeda ho .
. ( aawaz aai kay : )  aey zakriya ! hum tumhen aik aesay larkay ki khushkhabri detay hain jiss ka naam Yahya hoga . iss say pehlay hum ney iss kay naam ka koi aur shaks peda nahi kiya .
zakriya ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! meray yahan larka kiss tarah peda hoga jabkay meri biwi baanjh hai , aur mein burhapay say iss haal ko phonch gaya hun kay mera jism sookh chuka hai !
kaha :  haan ! aisa hi hoga . tumharay rab ney farmaya hai kay yeh to meray liye mamooli baat hai . aur iss say pehlay mein ney tumhen peda kiya tha jab tum kuch bhi nahi thay .

zakriya ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! meray liye koi nishani muqarrar farma dijiye .    farmaya :  tumhari nishani yeh hai kay tum sehat mand honey kay bawajood teen raat tak logon  say baat nahi ker-sako gay .
chunacheh woh ibadat gaah say nikal ker apni qoam kay samney aaye , aur unn ko isharay say hidayat di kay tum log subha o shaam Allah ki tasbeeh kiya kero .
. ( phir jab Yahya peda ho ker baray hogaye to hum ney unn say farmaya : )  aey Yahya ! kitab ko mazbooti say thaam lo .    aur hum ney bachpan hi mein unn ko danai bhi ata kerdi thi ,
aur khaas apney paas say naram dili aur pakeezgi bhi . aur woh baray perhezgar thay ,
aur apney walaiden kay khidmat guzaar ! naa woh sarkash thay , naa nafarman .
aur ( Allah taalaa ki taraf say ) salam hai unn per uss din bhi jiss roz woh peda huye , uss din bhi jiss roz unhen moat aaye gi , aur uss din bhi jiss roz unhen zinda ker kay dobara uthaya jaye ga .
aur iss kitab mein maryam ka bhi tazkarah kero . uss waqt ka tazkarah jab woh apney ghar walon say alehda ho ker uss jagah chali gaeen jo mashriq ki taraf waqay thi .

phir unhon ney unn logon  kay aur apney darmiyan aik perda daal liya .   iss moaqa per hum ney unn kay paas apni rooh ( yani aik farishtay ) ko bheja jo unn kay samney aik mukammal insan ki shakal mein zahir huwa .
maryam ney kaha :  mein tum say khudaye rehman ki panah maangti hun . agar tum mein khuda ka khof hai ( to yahan say hatt jao )
farishtay ney kaha :  mein to tumharay rab ka bheja huwa ( farishta ) hun ( aur iss liye aaya hun ) takay tumhen aik pakeezah larka dun .
maryam ney kaha :  meray larka kaisay hojaye ga , jabkay mujhay kissi bashar ney chooa tak nahi hai , aur naa mein koi bad-kaar aurat hun-?

farishtay ney kaha :  aesay hi hojaye ga . tumharay rab ney farmaya hai kay :  yeh meray liye aik mamooli baat hai . aur hum yeh kaam iss liye keren gay takay uss larkay ko logon  kay liye ( apni qudrat ki ) aik nishani banayen , aur apni taraf say rehmat ka muzahira keren .   aur yeh baat poori tarah tey hochuki hai .
phir huwa yeh kay maryam ko uss bacchay ka hamal thehar gaya , ( aur jab wiladat ka waqt qareeb aaya ) to woh uss ko ley ker logon  say alag aik door maqam per chali gaeen .
phir zachgi kay dard ney unhen aik khujoor kay darkht kay paas phoncha diya . woh kehney lagen :  kaash kay mein iss say pehlay hi mar-gaee hoti , aur mar ker bhooli basri hojati !
phir farishtay ney unn kay neechay aik jagah say unhen aawaz di kay :  ghum naa kero , tumharay rab ney tumharay neechay aik chashma peda kerdiya hai .
aur khujoor kay taney ko apni taraf hilao , uss mein say pakki hoi taza khujooren tum per jharen gi .

abb khao , aur piyo , aur aankhen thandi rakho .   aur agar logon  mein say kissi ko aata dekho to ( isharay say ) keh dena kay :  aaj mein ney khudaye rehman kay liye aik rozay ki mannat maani hai , iss liye mein kissi bhi insan say baat nahi kerun gi .
phir woh uss bacchay ko uthaye huye apni qoam kay paas ayen .   woh kehney lagay kay :  maryam ! tum ney to bara ghazab daha diya .
aey Haroon ki behan !   naa to tumhara baap koi bura aadmi tha , naa tumhari maa koi bad-kaar aurat thi !
iss per maryam ney uss bacchay ki taraf ishara kiya . logon  ney kaha :  bhala hum iss say kaisay baat keren jo abhi paalney mein parra huwa baccha hai-?
. ( iss per ) baccha bol utha kay :  mein Allah ka banda hun . uss ney mujhay kitab di hai , aur nabi banaya hai ,
aur jahan bhi mein rahun , mujhay ba-barkat banaya hai , aur jab tak zinda rahun , mujhay namaz aur zakat ka hukum diya hai ,
aur mujhay apni walida ka farmanbardaar banaya hai , aur mujhay sarkash aur sang dil nahi banaya .
aur ( Allah tala ki taraf say ) salamti hai mujh per uss din bhi jab mein peda huwa , aur uss din bhi jiss din mein marun ga , aur uss din bhi jab mujhay dobara zinda ker kay uthaya jaye ga .
yeh hain essa bin maryam ! inn ( ki haqeeqat ) kay baaray mein sachi baat yeh hai jiss mein log jhagarr rahey hain .
Allah ki yeh shaan nahi hai kay woh koi beta banaye , uss ki zaat pak hai . jab woh kissi baat ka faisla kerleta hai to bus uss say yeh kehta hai kay :  hoja  chunacheh who ho jati hai .
aur ( aey payghumber ! logon  say keh do kay : ) yaqeenan Allah mera bhi perwerdigar hai , aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar , iss liye uss ki ibadat kero . yehi seedha raasta hai .

phir bhi unn mein say mukhtalif girohon ney ikhtilaf daal diya hai , chunacheh jiss din yeh aik zabardast din ka mushaeeda keren gay , uss din unn ki bari tabahi hogi jinhon ney kufr ka irtikab kiya hai .
jiss roz yeh humaray paas ayen gay , uss din yeh kitney sunney walay aur dekhney walay ban jayen gay ! lekin yeh zalim aaj khuli gumrahi mein parray huye hain .
aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ko uss pachtaway kay din say daraiye jab her baat ka aakhri faisla hojaye ga , jabkay yeh log ( iss waqt ) ghaflat mein hain , aur emaan nahi laarahey .
yaqeen jano kay zameen aur iss/uss per saray rehney walon kay waris hum hi hon gay , aur humari taraf hi inn/unn sabb ko lotaya jaye ga .
aur iss kitab mein Ibrahim ka bhi tazkarah kero . beyshak woh sachai kay khoogar nabi thay .
yaad kero jab unhon ney apney baap say kaha tha kay :  abba jaan ! aap aesi cheezon ki kiyon ibadat kertay hain jo naa sunti hain , naa dekhti hain , aur naa aap ka koi kaam ker-sakti hain-?
abba jaan ! meray paas aik aisa ilm aaya hai jo aap kay paas nahi aaya , iss liye meri baat maan lijiye , mein aap ko seedha raasta batla dun ga .
abba jaan ! shetan ki ibadat naa kijiye .   yaqeen janiye kay shetan khudaye rehman ka nafarman hai .
abba jaan ! mujhay andesha hai kay khudaye rehman ki taraf say aap ko koi azab naa aa-pakray , jiss kay nateejay mein aap shetan kay sathi ban ker reh jayen .
unn kay baap ney kaha :  Ibrahim ! kiya tum meray khudaon say beyzar ho-? yaad rakho , agar tum baaz naa aaye to mein tum per pathar barsaon ga , aur abb tum hamesha kay liye mujh say door hojao .
Ibrahim ney kaha :  mein aap ko ( rukhsat ka ) salam kerta hun .   mein apney perwerdigar say aap ki bakhshish ki dua kerun ga .   beyshak woh mujh per boht meharban hai .

aur mein aap logon  say bhi alag hota hun , aur Allah ko chorr ker aap log jinn jinn ki ibadat kertay hain , unn say bhi , aur mein apney perwerdigar ko pukarta rahun ga . mujhay poori umeed hai kay apney rab ko pukar ker mein na-murad nahi rahun ga .

chunacheh jab woh unn say aur unn ( button ) say alag hogaye jinhen woh Allah kay bajaye pukara kertay thay , to hum ney unhen Ishaq aur Yaqoob ( jaisi aulad ) bakhshi, aur unn mein say her aik ko nabi banaya .
aur unn ko apni rehmat say nawaza , aur unhen oonchay darjay ki naik naami ata ki .
aur iss kitab mein musa ka bhi tazkarah kero . beyshak woh Allah kay chunay huye banday thay , aur Rasool aur nabi thay .
hum ney unhen koh-e-toor ki dayen janib say pukara , aur unhen apna raz daar bana ker apna qurb ata kiya .
aur hum ney unn kay bhai Haroon ko nabi bana ker apni rehmat say unhen ( aik madadgaar ) ata kiya .
aur iss kitab mein Ismail ka bhi tazkarah kero . beyshak woh waday kay sachay thay ,   aur Rasool aur nabi thay .
aur woh apney ghar walon ko bhi namaz aur zakat ka hukum diya kertay thay , aur apney perwerdigar kay nazdeek pasandeeda thay .
aur iss kitab mein Idrees ka bhi tazkarah kero . beyshak woh sachai kay khoogar nabi thay .
aur hum ney unhen rafat dey ker aik buland maqam tak phoncha diya tha .

Adam ki aulad mein say yeh woh nabi hain jinn per Allah ney inaam farmaya , aur inn mein say kuch unn logon  ki aulad mein say hain jinn ko hum ney nooh kay sath ( kashti mein ) sawar kiya tha , aur kuch Ibrahim aur Israel ( Yaqoob aleh-assalam ) ki aulad mein say hain . aur yeh sabb unn logon  mein say hain jinn ko hum ney hidayat di , aur ( apney deen kay liye ) muntakhib kiya . jab unn kay samney khudaye rehman ki aayaton ki tilawat ki jati toh yeh rotay huye sajday mein gir jatay thay .
phir inn kay baad aesay log inn ki jagah aaye jinhon ney namazon ko barbad kiya , aur apni nafsani khuwaishaat kay peechay chalay . chunacheh inn ki gumrahi boht jald inn kay samney aajaye gi .
albatta jinn logon  ney tauba kerli , aur emaan ley aaye , aur naik amal kiye , to aesay log jannat mein dakhil hon gay , aur unn per zara bhi zulm nahi hoga .

. ( unn ka dakhila ) aesay hamesha baqi rehney walay baaghaat mein ( hoga ) jinn ka khudaye rehman ney apney bandon say unn kay dekhay baghair wada ker rakha hai . yaqeenan uss ka wada aisa hai kay yeh uss tak zaroor phonchen gay .
woh uss mein salamti ki baaton kay siwa koi laghw baat nahi sunen gay . aur wahan unn ka rizq unhen subha o shaam mila keray ga .
yeh hai woh jannat jiss ka waris hum apney bandon mein say uss ko banayen gay jo muttaqi ho .

aur ( farishtay tum say yeh kehtay hain kay ) hum aap kay rab kay hukum kay baghair utar ker nahi aatay .   jo kuch humaray aagay hai , aur jo kuch humaray peechay hai , aur jo kuch inn kay darmiyan hai , woh sabb ussi ki milkiyat hai . aur tumhara rab aisa nahi hai jo bhool jaya keray .

woh aasmano aur zameen ka bhi malik hai , aur jo makhlooqaat unn kay darmiyan hain , unn ka bhi . lehaza tum uss ki ibadat kero , aur uss ki ibadat per jamay raho . kiya tumharay ilm mein koi aur hai jo uss jaisi sifaat rakhta ho-?
aur ( kafir ) insan yeh kehta hai kay :  jab mein mar-chuka hun ga to kiya waqaee uss waqt mujhay zinda ker kay nikala jaye ga-?
kiya iss insan ko yeh baat yaad nahi aati kay hum ney ussay shuroo mein uss waqt peda kiya tha jab woh kuch bhi nahi tha-?

to qasam hai tumharay perwerdigar ki ! hum inn ko aur inn kay sath saray shetanon ko zaroor ikattha keren gay ,   phir inn ko dozakh kay gird iss tarah ley ker ayen gay kay yeh sabb ghuttnon kay ball giray huye hon gay .
phir inn kay her giroh mein say unn logon  ko kheench nikalen gay jo khudaye rehman kay sath sarkashi kernay mein ziyada sakht thay .
phir yeh baat hum hi khoob jantay hain kay woh kon log hain jo sabb say pehlay iss dozakh mein jhonkay janey kay ziyada mustahiq hain .
aur tum mein say koi nahi hai jiss ka iss ( dozakh ) per guzar naa ho .   iss baat ka tumharay perwerdigar ney hatmi tor per zimma ley rakha hai .
phir jinn logon  ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya hai , unhen toh hum nijat dey den gay , aur jo zalim hain , unhen iss halat mein chorr den gay kay woh iss ( dozakh mein ) ghuttnon kay ball parray hon gay .

aur jab unn kay samney humari khuli khuli aayaten tilawat ki jati hain , toh kafir log mominon say kehtay hain kay :  batao , hum dono fareeqon mein say kiss ka maqam ziyada behtar hai , aur kiss ki majlis ziyada achi hai ?
aur ( yeh nahi dekhtay kay ) inn say pehlay hum kitni naslen halak ker-chukay hain , jo apney saz-o-saman aur zahiri aan baan mein inn say kahen behtar then .

keh do kay :  jo log gumrahi mein jaa parren toh unn kay liye munasib yehi hai kay khudaye rehman unhen khoob dheel deta rahey .  yahan tak kay jab yeh log woh cheez khud dekh len gay jiss say enhen daraya jaraha hai , chahye woh ( iss duniya ka ) azab ho , ya qayamat , to uss waqt enhen pata chalay ga kay bad-tareen maqam kiss ka tha , aur lashkar kiss ka ziyada kamzor tha .

aur jinn logon  ney seedha raasta ikhtiyar kerliya hai , Allah unn ko hidayat mein aur taraqqi deta hai . aur jo naik amal baqi rehney walay hain , unn ka badla bhi tumharay perwerdigar kay yahan behtar milay ga , aur unn ka ( majmooi ) anjam bhi behtar hoga .
bhala tum ney uss shaks ko bhi dekha jiss ney humari aayaton ko manney say inkar kiya hai, aur yeh kaha hai kay :  mujhay maal aur aulad ( aakhirat mein bhi ) zaroor milen gay .
kiya uss ney aalam-e-ghaib mein jhank ker dekh liya hai , ya uss ney khudaye rehman say koi ehad ley rakha hai-?
hergiz nahi ! jo kuch yeh keh raha hai , hum ussay bhi likh rakhen gay , aur uss kay azab mein aur izafa kerden gay .
aur jiss ( maal aur aulad ) ka yeh hawala dey raha hai , uss kay waris hum hon gay , aur yeh humaray paas tan e tanha aaye ga .
aur unn logon  ney Allah kay siwa doosray mabood iss liye bana rakhay hain takay woh inn ki pusht panahi keren .
yeh sabb ghalat baat hai ! woh toh inn ki ibadat hi ka inkar kerden gay , aur ultay inn kay mukhalif hojayen gay .
. ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya tumhen yeh maloom nahi hai kay hum ney kafiron per shayateen chorr rakhay hain jo enhen barabar uksatey rehtay hain-?
lehaza tum inn kay moamlay mein jaldi naa kero . hum toh inn kay liye ginti ginn rahey hain .
. ( uss din ko naa bhoolo ) jiss din hum saray muttaqi logon  ko mehman bana ker khudaye rehman kay paas jama keren gay ,
aur mujrimon ko piyasay janweron ki tarah hanka ker dozakh ki taraf ley jayen gay .
logon  ko kissi ki sifarish kernay ka ikhtiyar bhi nahi hoga , siwaye unn logon  kay jinhon ney khudaye rehman say koi ijazat hasil kerli ho .
aur yeh log kehtay hain kay khudaye rehman ki koi aulad hai !
. ( aesi baat kehney walo ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum ney bari sangeen harkat ki hai .
kuch baeed nahi kay iss ki wajeh say aasman phatt parren , zameen shaqq hojaye aur pahar toot ker gir parren .
kay inn logon  ney khudaye rehman kay liye aulad honey ka dawa kiya hai .
halankay khudaye rehman ki yeh shaan nahi hai kay uss ki koi aulad ho .
aasmano aur zameen mein jitney log hain , unn mein say koi aisa nahi hai jo khudaye rehman kay huzoor banda ban ker naa aaye .
yaqeen rakho kay uss ney sabb ka ehata ker rakha hai aur unhen khoob achi tarah gin rakha hai .
aur qayamat kay din unn mein say aik aik shaks uss kay paas akela aaye ga .
. ( haan ) beyshak jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , khudaye rehman unn kay liye dilon mein mohabbat peda kerday ga .

chunacheh ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney iss Quran ko tumhari zaban mein aasaan bana diya hai takay tum iss kay zariye muttaqi logon  ko khushkhabri do , aur issi kay zariye unn logon  ko darao jo zidd ki wajeh say jhagray per aamada hain .
inn say pehlay hum kitni hi qoamon ko halak ker-chukay hain . kiya tumhen tatolney say bhi unn mein say kissi ka pata milta hai , ya unn mein say kissi ki bhanak bhi tumhen sunai deti hai-?
